title: Elizondo's Imminent: people with Cherokee DNA have more experiences

tellings.quote: You read Luis Elizondo's book Imminent, it's in there. He says it seems to be that people with Cherokee blood and uh DNA have more experiences

plain: Jason Samosa, speaking as a witness on Jesse Michels's podcast, points to Imminent, a book by Lue Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who has spoken out about UFOs. Samosa says the book states that people with Cherokee ancestry seem to have more encounters with the unexplained, which, if true, would suggest these experiences are somehow tied to who a person is.
